name: enspyr-flyer-forge
description: Deployed forge instance for Delia's Enspyr A4 flyer. Depends on the pinned engine forge-web-app@v0.3.0 — NOT a snapshot copy. The worker bundles forge-web-app/worker from node_modules; the browser UI loads it from jsDelivr at the same tag (see public/index.html import map).
